title: Evidence portfolios for a workshop placement
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Applicant information | Reshelve Cabinetry Workshop
We have two three-week placements in February. The first is for people learning to prepare a project for cutting; the second is for people who already cut accurately and want to alter plans when a customer changes a requirement. Applicants may list both preferences, but they can be interviewed for only one placement.

For either placement, submit one photo of work that you did yourself. For the plan-adjustment placement, include an earlier drawing and a short note explaining what changed after that drawing was made. The picture does not need to be of a finished cabinet; clamps, a fitted divider, or scrap pieces used to test a joint can provide the evidence. A photograph of work done by a classmate does not meet the requirement, even if your instructor helps you describe it.

We read the note and look at the photo together. If the earlier drawing and note are missing, an application listing the cutting placement second can still be considered for that placement as long as its photo qualifies. We will not ask applicants to send missing drawings after the closing date. Please keep the actual work; nothing needs to be brought to the first interview.
passageZh:
文件 1｜申請須知｜瑞雪夫木作工場
我們在二月開設兩個為期三週的實習。第一個適合想學習如何準備裁切工序的人；第二個適合已能精準裁切、想學習如何在客戶改變要求時調整計畫的人。申請人可以把兩個實習都列入志願，但只會受邀面試其中一個。

不論申請哪個實習，都要提交一張照片，內容須是你親手做的作品。若申請計畫調整實習，還要附上較早的圖面，並簡短說明畫出那張圖之後改了什麼。照片不必拍完整的櫃子；夾具、裝好的隔板或用來測試接合的邊角料，都可以作為證明。即使老師幫你撰寫說明，若照片是同學的作品，仍不符合要求。

我們會一起看說明與照片。若未附較早的圖面與說明，而第二志願是裁切實習，只要照片符合要求，仍可列入該實習的審查。報名截止後，不會再請申請人補交缺失的圖面。請自行保留實物；第一次面試不需要帶作品來。
